specialHaftarot.title: Special Shabbath Hafṭaroth
specialHaftarot.note: These replace, or add to, the regular hafṭara of the seder read that Shabbath.

rows.name: Shabbath Shuva
rows.when: Any Shabbath between Rosh HashShana and Yom HaKippurim

rows.name: Shabbath Rosh Ḥodhesh
rows.when: When Rosh Ḥodhesh falls on Shabbath
rows.note: The Torah reading is Num 27:15–28:15, in place of the week's seder, and Isa 66 replaces the week's hafṭara.

rows.name: Shabbath Shĕqalim
rows.when: The Shabbath of Rosh Ḥodhesh Adar, or the one before
rows.note: The Torah reading is Exod 30:11–38, in place of the week's seder.

rows.name: Shabbath Zakhor
rows.note: The Torah reading is Deut 25:17–27:3, in place of the week's seder.

rows.name: Shabbath Para
rows.note: The Torah reading is Num 19, in place of the week's seder.

rows.name: Shabbath HaḤodhesh
rows.when: The Shabbath of Rosh Ḥodhesh Nisan, or the one before
rows.note: The Torah reading is Exod 12:1–28, in place of the week's seder.

rows.name: Rosh Ḥodhesh
rows.notes: Weekdays: four ʿăliyyoth. On Shabbath it replaces the week's seder, with seven.

rows.name: Parashath Shĕqalim
rows.notes: Replaces the week's seder, like a festival reading. Seven ʿăliyyoth.

rows.name: Parashath Zakhor
rows.notes: Replaces the week's seder, like a festival reading. Seven ʿăliyyoth.

rows.name: Parashath Para
rows.notes: Replaces the week's seder, like a festival reading. Seven ʿăliyyoth.

rows.name: Parashath HaḤodhesh
rows.notes: Replaces the week's seder, like a festival reading. Seven ʿăliyyoth.

rows.name: Purim
rows.notes: Weekdays: three ʿăliyyoth. On Shabbath it replaces the week's seder, with seven.

rows.name: The Rebukes in Wayyiqraʾ
rows.notes: Read on the Shabbath before Shavu'oth, in place of the week's seder. Seven ʿăliyyoth.

rows.name: Public fast days
rows.notes: 17 Tammuz, 10 Ṭeveth, Ṣom Gĕdhalya and Taʿănith Ester. Three ʿăliyyoth.

rows.name: The Rebukes in Dĕvarim
rows.notes: Read on the Shabbath before Rosh HashShana, in place of the week's seder. Seven ʿăliyyoth.

rows.name: Rosh HashShana, second day
rows.notes: One verse per ʿăliyya. Mafṭir: Num 29:1–6.

rows.name: Yom HaKippurim
rows.notes: Weekdays: six ʿăliyyoth. Shabbath: seven. At Minḥa: Lev 18, with Jonah and Micah 7 as hafṭara.
